# Employee Handbook
## Working Hours
Employees are expected to follow the working hours defined by their department.
## Attendance
Employees should maintain regular attendance and inform their manager when they cannot attend work.
## Professional Conduct
All employees are expected to communicate respectfully and maintain professional behavior.

title: Leave Policy
text:
# Leave Policy
## Leave Request
Employees must submit leave requests through the approved process.
## Manager Approval
Leave requests must be reviewed and approved by the appropriate manager before the leave begins.
## Emergency Leave
Emergency leave should be communicated to the manager as soon as reasonably possible.

text:
# Security Policy
## Password Security
Employees must use strong passwords and must not share passwords with other people.
## Confidential Information
Confidential company information must only be accessed by authorized personnel.
## Device Security
Company devices must be protected using approved security controls.
